supported_facts: Bloomberg reports the January 2022 auction of Melania Trump’s “Head of State” NFT.
The winning bid was 1,800 SOL, worth approximately $185,000 at the time; these express one transaction in cryptocurrency and its approximate contemporaneous dollar value.
Bloomberg traces transfers from a wallet associated with the project toward the wallet that placed the winning bid.
limits: The report concerns one auction/bid and does not establish total collection revenue or later Trump-family NFT sales.
A wallet link/transfer trail does not conclusively identify wallet controllers, establish intent, or demonstrate taxpayer funding.

claims: The collection earned more than $45 million in January 2022.
The cited investigation establishes wallet beneficial ownership or intent.
The cited report establishes later Trump-family NFT sales totals.
unsupported_original_claims_and_gap.gap: The Bloomberg report supports one 1,800-SOL bid and a reported wallet-transfer link. It does not establish overall collection revenue, who controlled the wallets, why transfers occurred, taxpayer funding, or later family NFT sales.
